summary: Iteration 3: validated master reassignment + per-zone master toggle. Backend 18/18 pytest tests pass (added TestSetMaster: reassign persists + single-master invariant + 404). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: master card renders once with Salon, master-zone-toggle only toggles that zone (header stays 'Actif'), master-shutdown-btn cascades to 'Arrêté', crown button on non-master card (Chambre parentale) promotes it → master card becomes Chambre parentale, old master (Salon) becomes normal zone with crown button, mode/fan/faults controls follow the new master. Restored Salon as master at end.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/system/master-power uses query param (?on=bool) — inconsistent with JSON-body convention used elsewhere; functional but worth normalising.
FastAPI startup/shutdown event decorators are deprecated; migrate to lifespan handlers.

PUT /api/zones no longer accepts is_master (good), but there is no server-side guard ensuring at least one master remains if data were ever manually edited — single-master is only enforced via set-master endpoint.
MasterZoneCard.jsx is ~270 lines and mixes identity, controls, and diagnostics — could be split into sub-components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Playwright renamed one non-master zone to 'TEST Zone Renamed' (was 'Cuisine' originally? actually first non-master card after reordering) — mock data, non-blocking. Master role was reassigned to Chambre parentale then restored to Salon.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows for iteration 3 verified. Backend regression suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers system, master-power, diagnostic, zones CRUD, set-master (single-master invariant + 404), devices, simulate, schedule. Temps update every 4s — do not assert exact temp values. Master role currently restored to Salon.
